notes.title: Dreamscape Update and Full Release
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are finally out of Early Access with the Dreamscape Update!

[h2]Isle of Dreams - Dreamscape Course[/h2]
Introducing the [b]Isle of Dreams[/b] course, showing off the Dreamscape themed content.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/09176d18e8b5a8b8d21068733215dbe80d0ffded.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/a45a84d01057cec2e5ad076bb0b7f3770b636ad8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
Also included in this update are Achievements! In total there are 21 achievements, including a few hidden ones. Note that the gameplay-related achievements are [i]not[/i] counted when testing in the course creator.

As always there are more new features and bug fixes to list as well, but before the changelog I want to address MiniGolf Maker's future as a full release.

[h2]Final Feature Update[/h2]
I have been working on MiniGolf Maker since 2015, so that would be almost 7 years I have dedicated to working on this game. In that time I graduated college and had 3 full-time jobs before deciding I wanted to quit my job and focus completely on game dev.

This game has been a big part of my life, and quite frankly I am completely burnt out. But now that it is out of Early Access I feel I that am finally able to move on. Working on this game has not been easy, especially during the time that I had full-time jobs that ate up 8 hours of my weekdays, meaning I spent almost all of my free time working on this game. There were many occasions where my motivation to keep working was extremely low, but I felt like I had an obligation to see this project through to some state that could be considered complete.

There are a lot of things about this game I am proud of, and just as many things that I regret. Even with that said, working on this game has provided me with invaluable experience for not only the technical aspects of game making, but also for the community and marketing aspects (mostly for what I need to do better). I will be sure to use everything I've learned here to make my next games even better.

So, with all that said, this will be the final feature update of MiniGolf Maker. I will still monitor the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1036660/discussions/1/]Problem Reports[/url] forum for bug reports, and release patches as needed, but there will be no new added features from this point on. I will be removing the Ideas and Feedback forum in accordance with this. 

Thank you to everyone who has supported this game. Thank you to everyone (both on Steam and on Discord) who has shared their courses, provided feedback, and posted bug reports. You have helped immensely in keeping me motivated to continue working on this game, and I hope to see you again on my future games.

Now, let's keep tradition by including the change log:

[h1][u][b]Changelog - 1.0.0[/b][/u][/h1]
[u][b]Features[/b][/u]
[list][*]Added new "Isle of Dreams" course.
[*]Added various Achievements.
[*]Added "Favorite Courses" option when selecting a course to play to view your favorite courses.
[*]Added ability to favorite courses when finished playing them.
[*]Added new course templates "Desert Dunes", "Alpine Heights", and "Tropical Island".
[*]Added option to turn on/off auto-snapping of greens.
[*]Added Action Menu button to manually join selected greens.
[*]Force zones can now be "Directional" (force moving in one direction) or "Radial" (force coming from the center of the zone).
[*]Added new effects that can be used to show force zones.
[*]Added Trigger Limit option to behavior sequences, so you can limit how many times a sequence can be started.
[*]Improved terrain brush accuracy.
[*]Reduced intensity of dreamscape sand texture bumpiness.
[*]Added ability to change the workshop item being saved when publish a course, so you can overwrite an existing course or publish as a new course.
[*]Added indicators to save and load course to show courses that have been published.
[*]Camera can now be pointed upward when aiming.
[/list]
[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list][*]Underside of green with flag now generates properly if it is a bridge.
[*]Fixed ball triggering Trigger Entered/Exited events when changing states inside of a trigger area.
[*]Fixed Trigger Event Behavior UI being broken.
[*]Various components of the Course Creator are now cleared when a new course is loaded, which should fix some issues.
[*]Fixed thumbnails for green styles.
[*]Fixed thumbnails for effects objects.
[*]Fixed potential publishing issues when loading a workshop course in the course creator.
[*]Fixed tee not being deleted when cancelling new hole creation.
[/list]

- Kevin

notes.title: Medieval Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A new update is here, and it's got some pretty cool things to offer. Without further ado let's go ahead and take a look at some of the stuff featured in this update!

[h2]Quest for the Golden Golf Ball[/h2]
Play the new 18-hole, Medieval-themed course "Quest for the Golden Golf Ball". Travel back to the Medieval ages and play through village, castle, and forest in search of the legendary Golden Golf Ball.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/bb61de3394a335243384814871b04d4208416cb2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/009a6c9436d1b6fd81d2be923a00e72b2b39632a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hazard Trigger Area[/h2]
The new "Hazard" trigger area allows you to set areas that will act as a hazard, immediately destroying the player's ball and ending their turn. Hazard trigger areas can also have effects like Fire, Splash, and Vaporize.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/db17d8a6fd377f8783330e89c0046c76c4c65f8c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Water Improvements[/h2]
Environment water has been completely changed. This new water not only fixes some visual issues, but also boasts a performance improvement in many cases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/1029c8e172e2833ecd5a5809e9210f902d40a722.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately, the Wave Size, Wave Direction, and Reflectivity options have been removed as the new water does not currently support them. I will investigate if these options can be added back in the future.

[h2]Object Skins[/h2]
Some objects can now have different "Skins" applied to them. The biggest example of this are the "Medieval Village" building pieces, which now have skins for wall and roof textures to help make your buildings more varied and interesting. You can change skins in the Properties window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/f0f794282a02ee01fb891e6dfb2d7431136a238c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Screenshot, Hole Preview, and Generate Banner[/h2]
The Screenshot, Hole Preview, and Generate Banner modes of the Course Creator have been improved to allow for more control over the camera. You can now zoom in and out and tilt the camera to make more interesting screenshots. You can even adjust how the camera moves and hide the UI if you want to record a video of your course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/f170102f9eb2954c07cbd2b24b31b64e4303acfa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Course Creator Saving and Loading[/h2]
Saving and loading courses in the Course Creator has been significantly improved. You now have more flexibility in managing your course saves, so you can save multiple copies of the same course.

The new menu also shows more information about the course, so that you can identify each course more easily. Note that old courses will not have updated information until they are saved again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/d6a2407eacaf48bc2f91e0278bbd1eeb5d3b42d6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Next Update[/h2]
There are only 2 more themes left to create an official 18-hole course for: Dreamscape and Polyworld. Rather than tell you which one I am working on, I'll leave it as a surprise this time :)

As far as other features, most notably I will soon be looking into achievements and unlockables. I have already begun thinking of ideas for achievements and things you can unlock. However, I will most likely wait until I leave Early Access to release achievements and unlockables, which will hopefully be some time this year!

Now, on to the detailed change log:

[h1][u][b]Changelog - 2021.3.0[/b][/u][/h1]
[u][b]Features[/b][/u]
[list][*]Added "Quest for the Golden Golf Ball" course.
[*]Added new "Hazard" trigger area.
[*]Added "Skin" feature that allows you to change the textures on parts of certain objects.
[*]Added fire effects to Special category.
[*]Added Birch and Oak tree nature objects.
[*]Added several new Medieval themed objects.
[*]In-game Course Creator tutorials are now complete.
[*]Added a prompt to do tutorials on first entering the Course Creator.
[*]Added hotkeys for tutorial proceed and quit.

[*]Revamped Course Creator loading and saving to allow saving copies of a course.
[*]Improved camera capabilities in screenshot, hole preview, and generate banner modes.

[*]Removed Wave Size, Wave Direction, and Reflectivity properties from water since the updated water does not support these currently.
[*]Improved loading screen visuals.

[*]Modified many objects to have more consistent visual styles.

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list][*]Fixed Fire power up not always affecting the ball correctly.
[*]Fixed Fire & Ice power ups not de-spawning under certain circumstances.
[*]Fixed green style editing in property window not working.

[h1][u][b]Changelog - 2021.2.0[/b][/u][/h1]
[u][b]Features[/b][/u]
[list][*]Added Arcade course, "Arcadia".
[*]Added more Arcade content, including new props, music, and a barrier style.
[*]Added letter and number objects.
[*]Removed "Arcade Interior" sky, this has been replaced with new "Interior Blue", "Interior Orange", and "Interior Gray" skies.

[*]Added ability to reset behaviors to their default values.
[*]Updated visuals for Pipe, Event, and Ball Trap trigger areas.
[*]Behaviors now run in Screenshot mode and Hole Preview mode.
[*]Improved event labeling in event lists.
[*]Path behavior now uses local position relative to the group the object is in.
[*]Added "Smooth" green style. Looks mostly like a normal green but behaves like ice.
[*]Added undo/redo for switching the active hole.
[*]Added undo/redo for creating and deleting holes.
[*]The action menu now follows the position it was opened at.
[*]Lights now get turned off in the course creator when the hole they are a part of is inactive.
[*]Holes now create their own "Reflection Probes" (in short, reflections and ambient lighting around holes look better)
[*]Added logging to course creator actions to help with debugging.
[*]Upgrade Unity version from  2018.2 to 2021.1 beta.
[/list]
[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list][*]Fixed water hitbox not updating when changing the sea level.
[*]Fixed power-up items not syncing correctly over the network when placed inside of groups.
[*]Fixed erroneous selection and action menu opening when confirming/cancelling moving objects.
[*]Fixed some issues with moving objects up and down.
[*]Fixed Move To Position behavior sometimes resetting position in the editor.
[*]Fixed some errors caused by event link lines.
[*]Fixed issues with undo/redo for color picking.
[*]Fixed events not duplicating correctly in some circumstances.
[*]Fixed issues with some course creator editor visual effects.
[*]Fixed selection being blocked by objects from inactive holes.
[*]Fixed some camera issues in course creator test mode.
[*]Fixed Visibility behavior not working with groups that have nested behaviors.
[*]Fixed collision issues with Move To Position behavior with a duration of 0, so that "teleporting" objects with behaviors are now possible.
[*]Fixed grouping relationship lines not being cleaned up.
[*]Fixed errors and some crashing when grouping.

[h1][u][b]Lights[/b][/u][/h1]
Lighting props got some love this month. You can now change the brightness and color of every light in the Properties window. You can also change light properties with the Light behavior.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/3edc69e1e7428d7ce01969f6f04357bbd4c0eac3.png[/img]

[h1][u][b]Ball Traps[/b][/u][/h1]
A new course element, the Ball Trap, has been added for you to play with. You can find it in the Special category of the object list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34639116/ebbd5a8af7feaa7ead8cbb50445cef0a3ba19d05.png[/img]
This trigger area will trap any ball that enters it at its center and can fire off events when a ball is trapped and released. You need to use the [b]Ball Trap[/b] behavior to release it. You can of course move the ball trap around with behaviors while a ball is trapped for some interesting holes!

[h1][u][b]Modding Package[/b][/u][/h1]
Modding support received a significant update to its architecture, and with that comes an update to the modding package. For those of you interested in modding I strongly recommend downloading the updated package. The updated package also contains new scripts for the new lighting functionality.

notes.title: MiniGolf Maker Modding Update

notes.title: MiniGolf Maker Check-In - June 8th, 2019

Hi everyone,

As I said in the last announcement, I was going to dedicate my time towards creating the behaviors and events system. Well, I have done just that and would like to show off what I've been up to. Unfortunately I cannot show the behaviors in action at the moment, but I can show some of the new UI for editing behaviors and events.

[u][b]Behaviors[/b][/u]
Most objects can have [b]sequences[/b] and [b]behaviors[/b] added to them:[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34639116/782046604ba36fad44fde43046f6184968426c51.png[/img]

As of now there are only 3 behaviors: Pause, Rotate, and Path, but I will definitely be adding more!

[u][b]Events[/b][/u]
You can set up events to trigger sequences on objects. You can either place trigger objects on the course that will be triggered when a ball rolls though them:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34639116/b6c6fcd57b6bb7be701ef62f8aa12d9e4c35f7b7.png[/img]

Or you can set up event triggers for when the hole is started and finished:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34639116/db01fa67173084aa790cd898efad703b6691f2dc.png[/img]

[u][b]Grouping[/b][/u]
A cool new feature is that you can group objects together. These groups can also have behaviors applied to them:

[h1][u][b]Coming Soon[/b][/u][/h1]
[u][b]Weekly Update Focus[/b][/u]
Starting this upcoming week, I would like to have a more specific focus for each weekly update. For example, focus a whole update on several new power-ups, or an update focused around improving a particular part of the game.
